items.title: How AWS Security Incident Response triages your security findings
items.summary: AWS Security Incident Response continuously triages the threat findings from Amazon GuardDuty and AWS Security Hub CSPM, but most of that work never shows up as a case. If cases are all you look at, it’s hard to tell whether the service is working at all, and that’s the question I hear most often when […]
